mutations.command: d=$(mktemp -d)/sdk; mkdir -p "$d/bin"; printf '#!/bin/sh\necho "Flutter 9.9.9 \xe2\x80\xa2 channel stable"\n' > "$d/bin/flutter"; chmod +x "$d/bin/flutter"; PEMO_FLUTTER_SDK="$d" bash apps/resident-mobile/tool/flutter-pinned.sh --version
mutations.note: Points the runner (via PEMO_FLUTTER_SDK) at a hermetic fake SDK that reports Flutter 9.9.9 — no real second SDK needed, so it bites the same in CI. The runner reads the pin from governance.yml, sees 9.9.9 != the pin, and refuses naming both. `expect` is pin-independent ('a local run on ... is a guess, not a gate') so a legitimate pin bump does not silently pass this bite.
